name: TCS
oa_pattern: NQT → Digital/Prime separation; coding + aptitude + verbal
resume: Clean 1-page; academics visible; 2 projects max highlighted
projects: Important for Digital/Prime—not just NQT pass
strategy: Clear NQT first. Parallel: 30 easy–medium DSA. Polish HireLens/Anony Talk bullets for Digital.

name: Infosys
oa_pattern: Online assessment + HackWithInfy path for better roles
hr_questions: Why Infosys over others?|Team conflict example|Learning agility
strategy: HackWithInfy if confident in UI/projects. Otherwise mass hiring OA focus.

name: Wipro
resume: Simple format; avoid over-design in PDF
projects: Explain one full-stack or frontend project
strategy: High-volume apply strategy. Low DSA depth OK if OA cleared.

name: Cognizant
projects: Valued in GenC Next / digital roles
strategy: Target GenC Next if projects strong (your profile fits).

name: Accenture
strategy: Emphasize product thinking from Anony Talk for digital roles.

name: Deloitte
oa_pattern: Aptitude + case-style questions for some tracks
strategy: Apply if GPA/communication strong; prep case-style HR.

name: Product Companies
oa_pattern: 2–4 OA rounds: DSA mediums + MCQs; system design lite later
resume: Impact metrics; links to live demos/GitHub
hr_questions: Why this company?|Conflict with PM|Failure story|Ownership example
strategy: Your path: frontend/product engineer—portfolio > 500 CP problems.

name: Startups
oa_pattern: Take-home + live coding + culture fit; often no standardized OA
communication: Authentic, curious, show what you shipped
hr_questions: Why startup?|Comfort with ambiguity|Side projects|48-hour task approach
strategy: Lead with HireLens + Anony Talk demos; contribute to open source.
